Quantum Leap Hackathon 2025

A fast-paced 36-hour sprint to build next-generation quantum computing applications.

Location & Format

Hosted at: San Francisco Innovation Lab, 450 Mission St

Format is in-person offline gathering.

Registration Due Date

Deadline: 2025-12-01

Who Can Apply

Open to undergraduate and graduate students currently enrolled in university. Teams must be between 2 and 4 members.

Awards & Bounty

First Place: $15,000 cash award. Runner up: $5,000 plus cloud credits.
